recommended_first_check: Perform a smoke test or visual inspection of the intake system for vacuum leaks.
reasoning: A P0171 code indicates that Bank 1 is running lean due to either too much unmetered air entering the engine or insufficient fuel delivery. A vacuum leak is the most frequent cause of unmetered air, followed by a dirty or failing MAF sensor. Identifying and eliminating vacuum leaks is the most logical and cost-effective first step in the diagnostic process.
